idea-plugin.name: Agent Review Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Agent Review Notes manages private, project-local review notes for code, files, and directories without changing source files or sending data over the network.

Features:

  • selection, caret, file, and directory notes with context-rich Git-aware anchors for multi-root projects;
  • a tool window, project badges, editor highlights, block inlays, details, navigation, and safe re-anchoring;
  • note types, statuses, tags, filters, icons, editing, deletion, and branch scoping;
  • validated dependencies, safe claiming, and dependency-aware execution plans;
  • a local, versioned JSON contract for integration with AI agents;
  • a bundled AI-agent skill installed through Install SKILL for listing, planning, claiming, and resolving notes.

The plugin never runs agents itself or inserts review comments into production code.
